distribution.narrative: Beaver & Liu (2010) directly records Taiwan, including Chiayi (A Li Shan) and Nantou (Neimoupu). Lin & Smith (2022) independently records Taiwan. No mainland province is inferred from either source.

host_note: Beaver & Liu (2010) reports Quercus sp.; the host is retained at genus level. Lin & Smith (2022) adds no promoted host evidence for this taxon.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cyclorhipidion ohnoi (Browne, 1980).

taxonomic_history.name: Cyclorhipidion ohnoi
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Beaver & Liu (2010) treats Cyclorhipidion ohnoi and records the 2010 new combination; canonical identity and authorship follow integrated taxonomic backbone: Cyclorhipidion ohnoi (Browne, 1980), VSN_2021.
